bagPolicy.summary: Bags must be clear and smaller than 12" x 6" x 12". Clutches and fanny packs up to 6" x 9" with one pocket do not need to be clear.
allowed: Clear bags smaller than 12" x 6" x 12"
Clutches and fanny packs up to 6" x 9" with no more than one pocket
Hydration packs, emptied, with no more than two main compartments and one small compartment
prohibited: Any bag that does not meet the bag policy
bagPolicy.note: All bags are searched. Policy from the festival help center, last updated March 2026. The festival is set to return June 4 to 6, 2027 at Harvard Athletic Complex, pending city license approval.

parking.note: Boston Calling is on hiatus in 2026 and has announced a return for June 4–6, 2027. Transportation plans are edition-specific; check the official site for the active venue and travel plan.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Boston Calling's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Boston Calling is on hiatus in 2026 and has announced a return for June 4–6, 2027. Food and beverage vendors change by edition; check the official site for the returning event's program.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Boston Calling, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Boston Calling's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Boston Calling's box office is located at the main entrance to the festival (65 North Harvard Street, Boston MA 02163).

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Boston Calling. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.

glance.label: Bags
glance.value: Bags must be clear and smaller than 12" x 6" x 12". Clutches and fanny packs up to 6" x 9" with one pocket do not need to be clear (posted for sports events; concerts may differ)
